SIP::discard
       Discards the current SIP message.

SYNOPSIS
       SIP::discard

DESCRIPTION
       Discards a SIP message

       SIP::discard

	    * Discards the current SIP message

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when SIP_RESPONSE {
	  SIP::discard
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.2.0 --First introduced the command.
